context.content: Reply to: https://hacdias.com/2023/01/10/11h15m30s70My compensation rights go through NS because I bought the ticket with them. And NS only refunds money after 1h delay. We’re over 1h delayed now but we’re expected to be able to recover part of it. After I arrive at my final destination I’ll look into it. Update: I am definitely missing my Eurocity train connection in Basel. That is certain.Yes, 1h - 25%, 2h - 50% is the procedure with DB as well, I think it’s an European law. Stay and visit Basel, it’s a beautiful city. 😄 (And it has the highest towers of 🇨🇭.) I wish you good luck though, let’s hope the delay doesn’t increase anymore!
